summary: Removes duplicates from an array, keeping the first occurrence of each value.
description:
Values are compared with `SameValueZero`, the rule a `Set` uses: `NaN` deduplicates against `NaN`, which `===` never
does, and `-0` collapses with `0`. Order is the order of first appearance, and the input is not modified.

Objects are compared by identity, so two objects with the same contents are two values. The optional `iteratee`
produces the key each value is compared by, which is how records are deduplicated by an id rather than by identity.
When keys collide, the earlier value wins.

params.array: The array to deduplicate. Left untouched.
params.iteratee: Produces the key a value is compared by. Values compare by themselves when omitted.

returns: a new array without duplicates, in the order of first appearance.

examples.title: Deduplicating records by a key
Collecting the distinct values of a column

<code-block lang="javascript">
function listStatuses(sheet) {
  const column = sheet.getRange("C2:C").getValues().flat();
  return unique(column.filter((status) => status !== ""));
}
